parts.answer: For normal renal function (eGFR >=90), the starting dose is 50 mg OD. For mild renal impairment (eGFR 60-89), the starting dose is 50 mg OD. For moderate renal impairment (eGFR 30-59), the starting dose is 25 mg OD, also stated as 25 mg once daily. For severe renal impairment (eGFR 15-29), the starting dose is Specialist review.
